verdict.rationale: Firstbase is a SaaS business-formation and back-office platform, so a documented public API is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence only describes dashboard and app interactions plus partner integrations such as Carta. Probes for OpenAPI specs and llms.txt all returned 404, and no public API documentation appears anywhere in the pack.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
